AutoMind Commands & Features:
  bolo / mic              Aawaz se bolkar command dein (Voice Input)
  chat <message>          Samanya bhasha me AutoMind se seedhe baat karein
  help                    Show this help menu
  doctor                  Run full system local health check
  test                    Run 19 automated system diagnostics
  app register <name>     Register a new target application (Tally, Excel, YouTube)
  app run <name>          Start interactive data collection and execution session
  app list                Show all registered applications
  synth <tool> <desc>     Auto-generate (AI-written when a key is set), test & inject a Python tool
  plan <task>             Decompose, track, and execute adaptive task steps
  learn <task> = <steps>  Directly teach AutoMind custom workflows
  calc <expression>       Exact 28-digit math / business calculator (agent_math_core)
  write <file> <text>     Save text directly to a file
  read <file>             Read content of a file
  agent <command>         Execute bounded direct OS actions
  backup                  Create a full timestamped backup of the project
  selfrepair full         Check syntax integrity of all project files
  selfrepair fix <file>   AI-repair a broken file (backup + confirmation)
  exit                    Close AutoMind

New engines:
  calculate 15% of 2400 | 5000 ka 18% gst kitna  -> agent_math_core (plain language works)
  evolve <goal> | evolve: add retry logic        -> agent_evolver (plan, self-modify, auto-rollback)
  status | rollback | benchmark | evolog [n]     -> evolution state, rollback, score, evolution_history.json
  build <description>                            -> AI writes a complete multi-file app/script in projects/
  project list | show <n> | edit <n> <change> | run <n>
  llm | key <provider> [key]                     -> BYOK (gemini | openrouter | anthropic | openai_compat)
  offline                                        -> toggle (also disables all LLM calls)
  actions | time | ping
Also: 'upgrade yourself to ...', 'ek calculator app banao', 'tally me entry karo', 'excel sheet banao' all work.
